note: REST menu items exposes a REST resource plugin rest_menu_item at /api/menu_items/{menu_name}; _format is required (json|hal_json|xml), max_depth/min_depth limit the tree, children nest under 'below'. Site config is the plain config object rest_menu_items.config (keys output_values, allowed_menus, base_url, add_fragment) edited at rest_menu_items.config_form (/admin/config/services/rest_menu_items, permission 'administer rest menu items'). allowed_menus is a checkbox map: empty = all allowed; a menu present but falsy returns 403; a menu whose value equals its machine name is exposed. base_url overrides the domain of absolute URLs for decoupled setups. Two alter hooks reshape the tree/output. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real rest_menu_items.config keys.

evals.prompt: Using the rest_menu_items module, what URL do I call to get the 'main' menu as a web service, and which query parameter is required for the request to succeed?
evals.expected_output: Call /api/menu_items/main and add the required _format parameter (json, hal_json or xml), e.g. /api/menu_items/main?_format=json. Without _format you get a 406.

evals.prompt: How do I limit the depth of the menu tree returned by the rest_menu_items endpoint, e.g. only the top level, and how are child items represented in the response?
evals.expected_output: Add max_depth (return up to that depth, e.g. max_depth=1 for top level only) and/or min_depth (start from that depth) query parameters. Child items are nested under a 'below' key.

evals.prompt: In rest_menu_items, which configuration setting restricts which menus can be requested over REST, and which setting overrides the domain used for absolute URLs in a decoupled setup? What config object holds them?
evals.expected_output: allowed_menus restricts which menus are exposed (empty = all; an excluded menu returns 403) and base_url overrides the domain for absolute URLs. Both live in the rest_menu_items.config config object (edited at /admin/config/services/rest_menu_items).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has rest_menu_items configured for a decoupled front end. Inspect the live configuration and give the base URL it uses for absolute menu-item URLs.
On this site, rest_menu_items has been configured to expose only one menu over REST. Inspect the configuration and state which menu is allowed.
evals.expected_output: rest_menu_items.config allowed_menus enables only 'main' ({ main: main }), so only the main menu is exposed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the rest_menu_items module so absolute URLs in its REST output use the base URL https://headless.example.test. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set base_url = https://headless.example.test in the rest_menu_items.config config object (e.g. via the settings form, drush config:set, or configFactory).

evals.prompt: I only want my footer menu available through the rest_menu_items web service. Using the module's configuration, mark the footer menu as an allowed/exposed menu on this live site.
evals.expected_output: In rest_menu_items.config, set allowed_menus so 'footer' is enabled (its value is 'footer'), e.g. allowed_menus = { footer: footer } via the settings form or configFactory.
